cases.name: zmq-pushpull
cases.doc: PUSH/PULL roundtrip over inproc and tcp (ephemeral :0, endpoint read back), single + multipart frames. Host-only: only shen-go ships a zmq host today — run via make bifrost-zmq.

cases.name: zmq-reqrep
cases.doc: REQ/REP over inproc: 3 request/reply round-trips in one thread. Host-only: only shen-go ships a zmq host today — run via make bifrost-zmq.

cases.name: zmq-pubsub
cases.doc: PUB/SUB topic-filter proof with slow-joiner publish+poll retry, then rcvtimeo drain proving non-matching topic filtered. Host-only: only shen-go ships a zmq host today — run via make bifrost-zmq.

cases.doc: rcvtimeo returns the shen.x.zmq.timeout symbol; poll 0/positive on empty socket → []; timeout? predicate. Host-only: only shen-go ships a zmq host today — run via make bifrost-zmq.

cases.name: zmq-errors
